items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I saw the first electric bass I think Monk or one of the Montgomery brothers came through with Lionel Hampton... Daddy was a very good trumpet player, he played with Lionel Hampton

ctx.x: That’s funny. What would the typical horn section be, a couple of saxes and —

Oh baritone, [scats] playing the bass line with that, ‘cause that was before the electric basses came in you see. I saw the first electric bass I think Monk or one of the Montgomery brothers came through with Lionel Hampton and that’s the first electric bass I ever saw. But before, and I tell people before that anybody was a bass player because they’d get on a bass and just slap on, you couldn’t hear no changes like formal changes, you couldn’t hear nothing.
